verdict.rationale: Entra ID's Lifecycle Workflows explicitly manage users across joiner/mover/leaver phases and trigger automated processes, and SCIM/app provisioning docs show automatic provisioning of users/groups into SaaS apps, supporting the JML-to-directory-and-app-assignment flow. However, the evidence pack never mentions inbound HR-system (e.g., Workday/SuccessFactors) connectors that make the HRIS the authoritative source of truth feeding Entra ID — it only shows Entra-as-source provisioning outward to apps. Missing for 10: explicit HR-driven inbound provisioning connectors, documentation of HRIS-to-Entra attribute flow, and independent/hands-on confirmation of end-to-end JML automation from an HR system.
